brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu is mounting an aggressive effort to secure his political survival despite cooling relations with the Trump administration, according to The Guardian. The Israeli prime minister faces mounting pressure as his grip on office appears tenuous, yet he continues pursuing strategies to prevent his removal.

Netanyahu's predicament centers on his legal jeopardy and domestic political isolation, though the exact mechanisms of his resistance remain unclear from available reporting. His administration's ability to retain power will depend on maneuvering within Israel's coalition government and managing international pressures simultaneously.
dek: The downfall of the Israeli PM may seem inevitable now; it is anything but. He must be ejected from office and brought to justice It’s unsporting to kick a man when he’s down. But let’s make an exception for Benjamin Netanyahu.
title: Netanyahu maneuvers to retain power despite Trump distance
